topics.name: Automation Missed-Run and Catch-up Policy
topics.purpose: Define explicit skip, run-once, bounded catch-up or other declared semantics for missed scheduled occurrences.

semantics.identity_rule: Reusable missed-run policy has explicit identity.
semantics.bound_rule: Catch-up maximum count/time window is explicit.
semantics.order_rule: Catch-up order is deterministic under schedule occurrence identity.
semantics.expiry_rule: Very old occurrences may expire according to explicit policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Catch-up executions still use current authorization/context policy.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown missed-run policy fails rather than replaying everything.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
